name: Kagura Mutsuki
source:
Hobbies: Fishing
Likes: Alcohol, women
Dislikes: Matters that are unclear

Kagura Mutsuki is an NOL general, and the head of the Duodecim's Mutsuki family known as the Black Knight as well as the representative Novus Orbis Librarium officer in the 5th Hierarchical City of Ibukido.

Kagura is shown to have a laidback attitude, taking things very casually, in stark contrast to some characters in the BlazBlue series. He is described to be more empathic to the people than the government. He is shown to be a pervert, attempting to grope [url=https://vndb.org/c25738]Makoto's[/url] breasts and analyzes most female opponent's B-W-H measurements. However, he has no interest in underage females such as [url=https://vndb.org/c25952]Platinum[/url] (he remarks how she should get back to him in 10 years in his Victory Quote) and repeatedly states how he dislikes entertaining men. However, in special cases, some females are exempt from his usual treatment, like [url=https://vndb.org/c25641]Tsubaki[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c20689]Kokonoe[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c25640]Rachel[/url] (although he still asks Rachel out on a date in his Victory Quote).

He tends to flirt with almost any woman he encounters and tries several times to invite [url=https://vndb.org/c25637]Noel[/url] to dates but they have all ended in failure due to Makoto's interference (mostly a punch in the face). On a serious note, Kagura became enraged and tried to kill Arakune when the latter attacked Noel, showing a protective side to him (although it is likely this extends to all women). He is also surprisingly humble as he frequently attributes his many "successes" to the fact that he has "great subordinates".
